Units 6 and 7 are base_text excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 1611-2365), covering MTP checkpoint reuse, sampling defaults, reasoning/tool parsing, template checks, vision caps, MiMo native admission, Flash-Next and the invariants/code map. Per file_changes (range_map_complete=true), the changed ranges are base 3, 128-130, 528 and 540-541. None of these fall inside the supplied units, so the lines shown are unchanged surrounding context.

The actual changes, visible only in the patch excerpt, are documentation edits:
- The last-updated date changes.
- The NemotronSuperServingPolicy.maximumEncodedBodyBytes doc goes from 8 MiB to 40 MiB, and oversize now returns media_too_large.
- New text says a JSON response_format with tools validates only call-free answers.
- Cache partitioning by authenticated scope is restated, which is consistent with T-041 mitigations.

The 40 MiB body ceiling is a raised DoS/memory surface (TB-007, T-029-adjacent). It is only documented here; the implementing source (NemotronSuperServingPolicy) is not supplied. That source should confirm that the shared 25 MiB decoded cap (MediaIngest.maxMediaDecodedBytes) and the memory-budget 503 still bound per-request allocation.

The JSON-format-with-tools behavior is a validation relaxation of output shape, not a security control. Integration should verify the source change matches the doc and that tool-call validation (schema, parallel cardinality) is unchanged.

No T-041 cache identity or scope regression is visible: the doc says the slot remains off without an authenticated scope.

No finding is raised, because there is no source evidence of a regression in these units.
